text:
eli: quick question — PR #6123 changes the per-model config annotation key from `model-config-checksum` -> `cfg-checksum`. I noticed a flurry of pod restarts in staging right after that merged, wondering if hot-reload might've been affected? can someone sanity-check?

infra-bot: CI: terraform-plan (linux) passed :white_check_mark:

eli: here's the k8s fragment we ended up applying in staging (from the kustomize overlay):
```
metadata:
  annotations:
    cfg-checksum: "sha256:abc123..."
```

sara: short answer — yes, that rename will break the hot-reload controller. it only looks for `model-config-checksum` today, so changing the key means the controller will think nothing changed and won't refresh the pods. that explains the stale flags + manual restarts.

kevin: can we do a short mitigation: terraform writes both keys for one release, then we change controller to read either key, then remove the old key in a follow-up? low-risk windowed migration.

sara: exactly. i'll open a tiny controller PR to be backwards-compatible: controller will check `meta.annotations.get("model-config-checksum") or meta.annotations.get("cfg-checksum")`. quick patch should be trivial.

eli: i can update the tf overlay in PR #6123 to emit both annotations while we roll the controller change. something like:
```hcl
locals { checksum = sha256(file("models/${var.model}/config.yaml")) }
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "model_cfg" {
  manifest = {
    metadata = { annotations = { model-config-checksum = local.checksum, cfg-checksum = local.checksum } }
  }
}
```

kevin: +1. make sure the rollout plan includes a canary for 10% first so we can validate no extra churn. also add a short wait-for-ready hook in the pipeline.

deploy-bot: staging redeploy finished for stack/model-service :thumbsup: all pods ready (3/3)

eli: ok i'll push the tf change to the PR branch and mark it WIP until sara's controller PR lands. after controller merges we'll flip a small canary then remove the duplicate annotation in a follow-up. thanks y'all. :pray:

sara: will open controller PR now and tag you, eli. ETA ~30m.

kevin: i'll add a one-line note to the rollout playbook about this edge case so oncall knows how to handle annotation renames in future.

eli: perfect, thx!
